text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: High GPU memory pressure on pool 'gdr-3' (eu-west). 12 alerts in 5m. PagerDuty incident #54321. Trigger metric: cuda_alloc_failed rate > 30%

incident-bot: Automated page fired by alerting policy `gpu.memory.high`. Group: eng-oncall. Attached sample logs below.

sara: ack - I'm on it. Starting triage. @dennis @maria please standby.

pagerduty-bot: Incident #54321 acknowledged by sara.

dennis: quick glance at infer-worker logs -> repeated errors: `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` and `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation`. Example:

```
2026-03-15T18:12:01Z infer-worker-7 model=chat-beta ERROR cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-15T18:12:02Z infer-worker-7 model=chat-beta ERROR cublas: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED
```

dennis: Eviction rate spiked on gdr-3, kv-cache evictions not keeping up. Might be large prefix traffic + long context requests.

maria: can we route traffic away from gdr-3 temporarily? thinking drain + scale up cpu-fallback pool then route heavy sessions to quantized variant. I'll try draining unhealthy nodes.

sara: running drain on node gpu-43 (part of gdr-3):

```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-43
kubectl drain node/gpu-43 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

incident-bot: Drain initiated on node gpu-43. Eviction progress: 4 pods evicted, 2 pods failed to restart (CrashLoopBackOff -> probable OOM).

jacob: if pods go CrashLoopBackOff after eviction they're hitting startup allocation peaks. Consider restarting nvidia driver on gpu-43 and checking kernel logs: `dmesg | grep -i cuda`.

dennis: also seeing kv_cache growth in model logs: many entries like `kv_cache_set(id=..., size=...)` with steadily increasing size for session ids. suspect caching leak for long-turn conversations. As a temporary mitigation we can flip route config to disable kv cache for chat-beta.

maria: patching route: `kv_cache.enabled=false` for chat-beta (canary first). Command: 

```
# internal API call (pseudocode)
POST /admin/routes/chat-beta/patch { "kv_cache": { "enabled": false }, "rollout": { "canary": 10 } }
```

maria: canary applied -> 10% of traffic on q4-quantized variant and kv_cache disabled. Monitoring memory.

sara: PagerDuty escalation policy: infra-eng will be paged if no resolution in 15m. tagging as `priority:high`.

maria: immediate effect: memory usage on gdr-3 reduced ~25% for canary pods (observed via node exporter). Alerts dropped to 3 in last 5m.

dennis: capturing heap/stack traces for the model server to investigate leak root cause. Will upload flamegraph to the incident thread.

jacob: infra note: nvidia driver reset performed on gpu-43 (ssh -> sudo systemctl restart nvidia-driver). Kernel logs show repeated: `NVRM: GPU at 00000000:03:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus` before OOM spikes. Could be driver instability under memory pressure.

sara: customer impact summary (quick): ~3% of requests in eu-west returned 5xx or timed out in the last 10m. Impacted customers observed: acme-corp, bravo-inc, charlie-ai (support tickets opened). No full pool outage but degraded latency and increased errors for long-context workloads. Posting preliminary note to status.redwood.com/incident-54321.

incident-bot: Incident progress: alerts reduced to 3 in last 5m, auto-shedder triggered on two heavy routes, autoscale attempted +2 cpu-fallback nodes.

maria: recommended follow-ups: 1) revert kv_cache change to true after root cause fixed, 2) add guardrails to limit per-session prefix size, 3) prepare patch to kv cache eviction strategy.

dennis: I'll run a `perf` capture and upload traces. Likely need a codefix in prefix caching codepath.

sara: Handoff plan -> I'm handing off to @eli (night-oncall) in 25 minutes. Summary for handoff: node gpu-43 drained, kv_cache disabled for chat-beta canary (10%), q4-quantized canary 10% active, infra restarted nvidia driver, alerts reduced but still under watch. PagerDuty #54321 remains open.

eli: ack. I'll take monitoring and escalate to infra if alerts climb above 5 in 5m. Will also coordinate customer comms with support. :thumbsup:

sara: thanks all. adding playbook links: https://internal.playbooks.redwood/gpu-memory and pinned logs in incident doc.

incident-bot: Incident #54321 updated: status=mitigating, assigned=sara -> eli (handoff scheduled).

eli: watching dashboard now."
